description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station trigger, untapping all creatures and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat.
